text: I got tired of always having to update my wife, and my family members résumés. So I created https://theresumechef.com It's private,free to use, no pay walls or monthly subscriptions.It has10 resume templates to choose from to get you started.The final resume can be exported as a PDF, or stored on Google Drive or Dropbox in JSON format. There are still a few issues, but I've learned a ton by just creating and launching this project. I have some exciting new product ideas, but I'm currently waiting on my Dutch KvK number to accept online payments with Stripe.
